method: delta = P(A+X beats B) - P(A beats B), tie = 1/2, same fight seed for both; A and B are same-round payloads from different games of the corpus; X fresh (no buffs) in the better of two row rules. Front: first empty front slot, else A's weakest front unit moves to an empty back slot and X takes its place, else X replaces the weakest front unit. Back: first empty back slot, else first empty front slot, else X replaces the weakest back unit (weakest = lowest attack + health). In tribe: A has >= 3 units of one of X's tribes before X is added. Recruit-phase text (battlecries, end of turn, shop effects) never runs: this is fight value only.
